cotton.overview: Cotton is a natural plant fibre that is breathable, absorbent and durable, and it handles regular washing well.
cotton.washing_method: Machine wash, normal or gentle cycle
cotton.detergent: Normal liquid or powder detergent; use a colour-safe detergent for dark colours
cotton.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
cotton.bleaching: Oxygen bleach on whites only; avoid chlorine bleach on coloured cotton
cotton.special_care: Avoid excessive heat, which can cause shrinkage; wash dark colours separately
cotton.avoid: very hot water, overloading the drum, high-heat tumble drying
cotton.rationale: Cotton generally tolerates moderate washing temperatures, so a 30–40°C wash is recommended.

silk.overview: Silk is a fine natural protein fibre that is smooth and lustrous but weakens with heat, friction and harsh chemicals.
silk.washing_method: Gentle hand wash or delicate machine cycle in a mesh bag
silk.detergent: Mild pH-neutral detergent made for delicates
silk.drying_method: Air dry flat or hang in shade
silk.drying_without_dryer: Air dry flat away from direct sunlight
silk.ironing: Low (up to 110°C), on the reverse side, no steam
silk.special_care: Avoid wringing, direct sunlight, and perfume or deodorant sprays that can stain
silk.avoid: chlorine bleach, wringing, hot water, long soaking
silk.rationale: Silk fibres weaken with heat and harsh detergents, so a gentle, cold wash is recommended.

wool.overview: Wool is a natural animal fibre that is warm and elastic but shrinks and felts when exposed to heat and agitation.
wool.washing_method: Wool or gentle cycle, or hand wash
wool.detergent: Mild wool-safe detergent; avoid enzyme-based detergents
wool.drying_without_dryer: Dry flat on a towel and reshape while damp
wool.ironing: Low (up to 110°C) with a pressing cloth
wool.special_care: Avoid high heat and agitation, which cause felting and shrinkage; never hang heavy wet wool
wool.avoid: hot water, wringing, tumble drying, harsh detergents
wool.rationale: Wool shrinks and felts with heat and agitation, so a cold, gentle wash and flat drying are recommended.

linen.overview: Linen is a strong natural fibre made from flax; it is cool and breathable but wrinkles easily.
linen.washing_method: Machine wash, gentle or normal cycle
linen.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
linen.drying_with_dryer: Tumble dry low and remove while slightly damp
linen.drying_without_dryer: Air dry; shake out and smooth while damp
linen.ironing: High (up to 200°C), ideally while damp or with steam
linen.special_care: Linen wrinkles easily, so iron while damp; over-drying makes it stiff
linen.avoid: chlorine bleach, over-drying, long soaking of coloured linen
linen.rationale: Linen is strong but wrinkles and stiffens when over-dried, so a moderate wash and damp ironing are recommended.

polyester.overview: Polyester is a durable synthetic fibre that dries quickly and resists wrinkles, but it is sensitive to high heat.
polyester.washing_method: Machine wash, normal or synthetic cycle
polyester.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
polyester.special_care: High heat can melt or permanently crease the fibres; avoid hot irons and high-heat dryers
polyester.avoid: high heat, hot irons, fabric softener build-up
polyester.rationale: Polyester is heat sensitive, so a moderate wash with a low-temperature iron is recommended.

denim.overview: Denim is a thick cotton twill that is dyed with indigo, which can fade and bleed in the wash.
denim.washing_method: Machine wash inside out, normal cycle
denim.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
denim.special_care: Wash inside out and separately at first because indigo dye can bleed; wash less often to preserve colour
denim.avoid: bleach, hot water, washing with light garments
denim.rationale: Denim dye fades with heat and friction, so a cool, inside-out wash is recommended.

nylon.overview: Nylon is a strong, lightweight synthetic fibre that is smooth and elastic but melts at high temperatures.
nylon.washing_method: Machine wash, gentle or synthetic cycle
nylon.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
nylon.bleaching: Do not use chlorine bleach (it causes yellowing)
nylon.special_care: Heat can melt nylon; wash apart from lint-shedding fabrics and use a mesh bag for delicate items
nylon.avoid: chlorine bleach, high heat, hot irons
nylon.rationale: Nylon is strong but heat sensitive, so a gentle wash at a low temperature is recommended.

rayon.overview: Rayon (viscose) is a soft, semi-synthetic fibre made from cellulose that drapes well but is weak when wet.
rayon.washing_method: Gentle machine cycle or hand wash
rayon.drying_with_dryer: Tumble dry low only if the care label allows
rayon.drying_without_dryer: Air dry flat or on a padded hanger
rayon.ironing: Low to medium (up to 150°C) on the reverse side
rayon.special_care: Rayon is weak when wet, so avoid wringing and heat; shrinkage is possible
rayon.avoid: wringing, hot water, high heat, long soaking
rayon.rationale: Rayon loses strength when wet and shrinks with heat, so a gentle cold wash is recommended.

velvet.overview: Velvet has a soft raised pile that is easily crushed, and some velvets are dry-clean only.
velvet.washing_method: Gentle cycle or hand wash; check the label, some velvet is dry-clean only
velvet.ironing: Do not iron directly; steam from the reverse side
velvet.special_care: Crushing the pile leaves marks; check the care label because some velvets are dry-clean only
velvet.rationale: Velvet's pile is easily crushed by heat and pressure, so a gentle cold wash with steam-only finishing is recommended.

blended.overview: Blended and synthetic fabrics combine fibres, so care must follow the most sensitive fibre in the mix.
blended.washing_method: Machine wash, gentle or synthetic cycle
blended.drying_method: Air dry or tumble dry low
blended.ironing: Low (up to 110°C), following the most sensitive fibre
blended.bleaching: Avoid bleach unless the label allows it
blended.special_care: Follow the care label and use the setting for the most delicate fibre; high heat may shrink, melt or crease the fabric
blended.rationale: Blends should be treated according to their most heat-sensitive fibre, so a gentle 30°C wash is recommended.
